title: Amount of a Security Deposit Refund on a Passed Review
content:
**Commission rates for interest paid within a refund.** The Commission's deposit interest rates are 3.85% (0.0385) for calendar 2024, 4.02% (0.0402) for calendar 2025 and 4.17% (0.0417), the annual interest rate of every Security Deposit kind, for calendar 2026 onward.

**Clause.** A passed review refunds the cash received less the cash already refunded, plus the interest credited on the deposit, plus interest on the cash received for the period since the latest interest credit at the Commission's deposit interest rate for the calendar year of the refund date, by days over 365, rounded to the cent.

**Terms.** The cash received is the total of the deposit payments; the cash already refunded is the total of earlier refunds paid out of the deposit; the interest credited is the total of the interest credits on the deposit. The period since the latest interest credit runs from the period end of the latest interest credit on the deposit, or from the fully secured date when none has been credited, to the refund date, its days counted from the start date to the refund date, the start date not counted.

## Worked example (hypothetical deposit)

Cash received USD 480.00; nothing refunded earlier; one interest credit of USD 20.02 with period end 12 May 2026; refund date 1 September 2026.

| Element | Figure |
|---|---|
| Cash received less cash already refunded | 480.00 |
| Interest credited | 20.02 |
| Days from 12 May 2026 (not counted) to 1 September 2026 | 112 |
| Rate for calendar 2026 | 4.17% |
| Interest for the period: 480.00 times 4.17% times 112 over 365 | 6.1419, rounded to 6.14 |
| Refund | 480.00 plus 20.02 plus 6.14, which is 506.16 |
